media.caption: A 1907 print documents a surviving mound centuries after Cahokia’s urban era. It cannot show the vanished houses, working spaces or full urban population. Compare its narrow field of view with archaeological evidence for the larger settlement.
notice: What occupies most of this photograph?
Which parts of city life would leave little trace in this view?
media.creator: National Photographic Library, copyright credit on the original
media.relevance: Distinguishes later documentation from evidence of an occupied city.
media.datingNote: The catalogue dates the print c1907 and its title names 16 October 1907. This is later documentation, not a picture of the occupied medieval city.
